name: Stripe subscription cancelled → Frank churn interview invite

parameters.content:
### How it works
This workflow helps subscription product teams invite a customer to a short Frank AI Researcher (Frank) voice interview after a Stripe subscription ends. Frank is an AI user researcher that runs short voice interviews. The Stripe Trigger listens for `customer.subscription.deleted`. A Stripe node then loads the customer so the workflow can read their email. If the customer has no email, the workflow stops. If they do, it sends an invite from your mailbox with the interviewer link you paste into the configuration node. The default path does not call Frank over MCP. An optional branch can look up a published study with Frank's `list_researches` tool after you connect an MCP OAuth2 credential. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and Muse. Frank MCP has not been validated in n8n.

### Setup
Connect a Stripe credential (Secret key, and a Signature Secret after you publish the workflow). Connect an SMTP credential for the Send Email node. In Frank, create and publish a churn study, then paste the interviewer link into the configuration node, along with your from-address, company name, and study name. Test in Stripe test mode before going live.

### Customization
Edit the email subject and body. To invite someone when they cancel at period end, rather than when the subscription actually ends, see the README. The MCP branch is optional: Frank does not offer Dynamic Client Registration, so you need MCP OAuth2 set up as described in the README.

## 1. Detect a subscription that has ended

Stripe sends `customer.subscription.deleted` when the subscription actually ends, which may be after a cancel-at-period-end request. The next node loads the customer so the workflow can read their email.

## 2. Configure the invite and send email

Paste your published Frank interviewer link and sender details here. If the customer has no email, the workflow stops instead of sending a blank invite.

## 3. Optional: look up a published study via Frank MCP

Off by default. Needs an MCP OAuth2 credential. Frank does not support Dynamic Client Registration (`POST /oauth/register` returns 404). See the README. This branch only calls `list_researches` (read). It does not create or publish a study.

## Replace the interviewer link before you publish

Do not send customers the placeholder URL. Create and publish a churn study in Frank, then paste the interviewer link into the configuration node.

## Optional MCP step: needs Frank OAuth

Leave `useFrankMcp` set to false unless you have connected an MCP OAuth2 credential for https://api.hifrank.ai/mcp. Generic OAuth2 is a poor fit (no Resource URL field). See the README.
